en.text: Relevant character names from the game Deadlock.

And that's it. Thanks for watching. If you liked this video, please subscribe to the channel. And I'll see you in the next one. Bye-bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye.
I knew I could count on you, Holliday…
We need to capitalize on this!
It's a joy watching you work, Abrams…
The Detective will run through them all…
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
The guardian will deal with them.
Time for the guardian to earn its keep.
Paradox played her part to perfection…
Letting someone else do the work, eh Paradox?
They took out the Test Pilot!
You're a team player, Dynamo: thank you.
I thought they had you, Geist…
That was a joy to watch…
You're a woman of talent, Haze.
They never even heard the shot that killed him…
Glad you're on my side, Vindicta…
Infernus, there is so much we can accomplish together…
That was never was going to last…
Nothing will stand between us and completing the ritual…
What game are you playing at Kelvin…
Don't think this buys my loyalty.
Kelvin's dead…that saved me some time later.
They killed kelvin… someone's getting a fruit basket later.
I don't think I could have hit that…
They took out the Rat King!
That man has earned my respect.
I could learn a few things from Shiv.
Shiv is ruthless… I love it.
Ivy, you are saccharine, but useful.
Good god, Warden, that was madness…
You played your part well, Wraith.
Your skills speak for themselves, Yamato…
And they thought they could escape Yamato.
Powers are ready to be upgraded.
I can't forget to upgrade my abilities.
I don't have back up, I need to be careful.
Need to make sure I check in with the others.
We can't afford to fail now…
We need to get it together…
Can't afford to get sloppy now…
And THAT'S how you remove an obstacle.
It's nice to have quality help.
Need to make every bullet count…
That should take the smug look off their face…
Run while you still can, Holliday…
You can't contain me for long!
that laser was never going to be enough…
I won't be killed by the likes of you, Paradox…
You were a fool to fight me, Paradox…
look out for the black hole!
Keep your distance from the Professor….
McGinnis relies too much on these things…
Damn it, they got the Rejuvenator.
They got the Rejuvenator, we need a plan.
They have the Rejuvenator, we can't afford to throw our lives away.
Your ego was your undoing Geist
You thought you were untouchable Geist… you were wrong
With a little planning, anyone can be killed.
Be careful, Geist can steal our health…
Don't let Geist get too close to you!
There's no hiding from me, Haze!
There was nowhere to run, Haze.
You thought you could hide from me?
And she fancied herself a predator…
Vindicta learned a valuable lesson today…
I won't be bested by a bartender…
You can't run from me, Kelvin…
You got what you deserved, Kelvin.
Get this mole off of me!
Get away from me, you mole!
You were never going to land, Lash.
Don't let Grey Talon catch you!
We need to work together to stop Shiv!
They have no hope against us…
We are strong… they are weak…
We'll pick them off one by one.
I'm no stranger to blood on my hands.
They'll be dead to the last man.
You have no authority over me, Holliday.
I was never going to be stopped by someone in a cowboy hat.
Your grandfather would be so disappointed, Holliday
Some cases were never meant to be solved.
You were doomed the moment you crossed me, Abrams.
Put her out of her misery.
I just did the city a favor.
She put up more of a fight than I was expecting.
At the end of the day, Bebop, you're just a machine.
No robot will ever match my cunning.
I'm not losing to a brute like you.
Optimism will get you nowhere, Paige.
You couldn't save yourself, Paige, what chance do you have to save your friends?
Today will not end well for you, child.
You should know when to surrender.
Spare me your fortune cookie wisdom.
Paradox won't be bothering us for a while.
I tire of your games, Paradox.
Fairfax will only let you down.
That will buy us some quiet time.
Today has gotten rather interesting, now hasn't it?
I will know your secrets, Doorman…
I'll see you at The Baroness, Doorman.
This is far from over, Doorman.
The old must make way for the new.
You never should have crossed my path, Drifter.
Professor Dynamo, it was a great honor.
You don't have the instinct for this, Professor.
Dynamo is no longer a threat.
I almost feel a twinge of guilt. Fascinating.
Better to die at my hands, then end up with the OSIC.
I have stained my hands with the blood of kings.
Your father will be so disappointed.
You never even considered failure, did you Apollo?
Your toys are no match for me.
What chance does a laborer have against perfection?
You really thought you had a chance, didn't you…
You don't know a thing about real suffering, Victor.
Your unnatural life has come to an end…
I'm not one of your petty sacrifices, Geist.
You chase power, but I AM power…
The likes of us don’t get the benefit of mercy, Geist.
The OSIC will never stop me.
Haze met the fate of the many that came before her.
I won't be stopped! Not by Kelvin, and not by you!
Vindicta won't be a problem anymore.
I appreciate your skills, Infernus, but it's not enough.
A pity we couldn't work together, Infernus…
It was always going to come down to you and me, Kelvin…
A pity, Krill, I had use for you two…
I told you, Maurice: Krill is holding you back.
His ego is almost as big as Kelvin's…
I will beat humility into you, Lash.
Ah the folly of young love…
I’d rather my fate than theirs.
Party tricks were never going to stop me.
The djinn will always fail because they ask when they should take.
The Djinn need to find better pawns.
Her talent did not match her reputation.
The black sheep of the Baxter Society is dead.
You need to be more discerning with your contracts, Calico.
You have much to learn, Graves.
You have no idea who you're dealing with, Graves.
Your mentor has failed you, Graves.
You're not the dead's master… you're their errand girl.
Just die with dignity, old man.
The hunter has become the prey.
Today keeps getting better and better.
I'm not afraid of you, Venator.
You've never hunted anyone like me before, Father.
To suffer is divine, isn't it Venator?
You are the king of nothing.
I've had to live among filth like you for too long.
And so our arrangement has come to an end
Like knives were going to stop me…
Shiv won't be bothering us for a while.
This is not the place for a child.
Do I look like some petty goon, Ivy?
You've stepped in the deep waters, Ivy.
Go back to your little side show.
She has more power than she lets on…
You know nothing of real power, Mina.
It's adorable that you thought you could stop me.
I tire of your prattling, Vyper.
That goo suit was never going to protect you…
What happens on the surface is none of your concern, Viscous.
You trained your whole life for this moment, Warden… how sad.
You made a lot of promises you couldn't keep, Warden.
You'll never stop the Ritual, Warden.
Like you ever had a chance at stopping me, Warden…
Better have tried to hunt me, Silver.
I put the wolf out of her misery.
You never had a chance, Silver.
I will never be bound again!
You have plenty of style, Wraith, just no substance.
Slink off to whatever plane you come from, worm.
Your feast comes to an end Wrecker
You fancy yourself a monster? Amature.
I showed Wrecker what a real killer looks like
Leave New York while you still can, Yamato.
The 7th Moon should never have gotten in my way.
This city belongs to me now!
Has the futility set in yet?
The city will know my brilliance!
Feel free to hide… it only delays the inevitable.
You will see what true power looks like.
Be honored to die at my hand.
Walk away from this. It won't get better.
Of course it's up to me…
And once again I am the Omega…
I'm not looking to die like the rest of my team.
I need to get back to work.
My team needs me out there.
Enough rest, it's time to fight.
You're on your own for now.
I'll be back when I can.
We haven't. But I am fascinated by what you hold.
Don't worry Detective. I know better.
That tome is pulling you into deep waters Detective, be careful
Yet here I stand. Perhaps you should consider that I know what I'm talking about.
I offended small minded simpleton's with fragile egos.
Please. They tried to eradicate my soul and I merely destroyed their bodies. If anything I was magnanimous.
You made a mistake joining this Ritual.
For now, perhaps. But you're about to reveal your true power to New York. How long before the authorities decide you're too feeble and confused to wield your magic safely?
It's not a matter of need, it's a matter of opportunity. They are a resource to be exploited.
They know exactly what I want and why. Now the ones hiding their motivations? Those are the people that need to tread softly.
Your attachment to your charge makes you weak Bebop.
I'm sure she's a lovely woman. The fact remains that if I considered you a threat, I would go through her to get to you.
I'm sure you'll give me no reason to say hello.
My dear scrap golem, I'm not like any man you've ever met in your life.
Bebop, you should be relieved, not suspicious. Thanks to me your precious Miss Shelly has a chance to live out the rest of her pleasant yet unremarkable life.
You're the bibliomancer are you not?
Good. Then you haven’t outlived your usefulness.
Does it pertain to the ritual?
Of me? Of the ritual? Of those who oppose us?
Why do you waste your days in central park?
You're sitting around playing a game when you could be changing the world.
Then you're more foolish than I thought.
Solomon, how does it feel knowing you'll be complicit in my ascension.
Your too committed with the ritual to stop me
I'm a surprised Fairfax isn't concerned about you being seen with me
You're a fool to trust Fairfax.
He'll cast you aside the second you become an inconvenience, or worse: dare to have a vision of your own.
I'm not sure who is strapped to a worse death trap, me or you.
What you do on sabbatical is none of my business
I don't fear you. It's just not worth risking the temper tantrum of an errant force of nature costing me the ritual.
I could think of some civilizations that would disagree.
Why would it? The pursuit of power is endless.
It's a good thing I'm not playing then.
Spoken like a man who never attained it.
Watch me Drifter, and see for yourself.
I have nothing to prove to you Drifter… but you will be impressed none the less.
I don't understand you, professor… you've been bestowed a great gift, and you're willing to throw it all away for nothing.
No. Easy words to say when you have.
I'm a fan of your work Professor.
Your research into the Astral Gates paved the way for my own. In my rare moments of doubt, sometimes I even wonder if I would have became the man I am were it not for you.
I mean no disrespect Professor, but some things may be beyond you.
Hm. Perhaps we're cut from the same cloth.
I see the Patron looks to test my patience today.
Fine. Rem. Listen to me. If the ritual fails and you are on your own, stay away from anyone who mentions the OSIC.
They will not help you get home. Trust me.
No, you have a yoke that you chose to don.
I don't have time to wax poetic about the indignities I suffered.
Once I've rendered them helpless, run them through.
No. But there is glory in victory. And victory is all that matters today.
Your construction is magnificent. Truly inspired.
Heavens no. I'm interested in becoming a god, not playing one.
Are you ready to do whatever it takes?
Oh, so the state tried obliterate your soul from existence?
I would think that it would be a memorable experience.
So you're the sheriff from macomb…
This should prove to be interesting.
Look at you. So consumed by revenge that you'll even fight alongside me.
Apologies. I would never dream of upsetting you Holliday.
When this is over, if you are determined to throw your life away I will be happy to take it.
You haven't heard. She's writing a story about me.
Rejoice, Holliday. Soon you will get the revenge you seek.
Look who stands with you. They don't have a chance.
You're too smart to be that naive.
For all the might your organization wields, you waste it on publicity stunts.
I would settle for you explaining it to anyone.
But if I proposed something… would you consider it?
All your brilliance is wasted toiling for Fairfax.
So you're content with being a wage slave?
I think it's safe to say you plateaued
You are a woman who executes pedestrian ideas at the highest level. That makes you a master craftsman, but far from a visionary.
I see you're finally addressing your Oathkeeper problem.
I know that Faustian bargains rarely have happy endings.
I think public image is the least of your worries.
Your pursuit of vanity is as pathetic as it is cliché
This must eat at you. Fighting beside me.
We're going to have so much fun together.
Do your superiors know that you're helping me?
I assume 48 hours is a pipe dream.
Look at us. Both victims of the state.
I'm grateful to fight beside someone who has shed the albatross of morality.
It will be a pleasure Vindicta.
All your power and you waste it as a bartender.
The life you had before you put yourself in a muzzle… do you miss it?
Please: I don't like murder. I'm indifferent to it.
What do I have to fear from an inept government?
Then I let you stew on when I'll come to kill you.
Don't worry Kelvin, I won't let you die.
I do. But if anyone is going to kill you, it's going to be me.
Kelvin: whatever it is you are now is a pale imitation of the man you were. To mock someone in your state of frailty is beneath me.
Kelvin, whatever it is you are now is a pale imitation of the man you were. To mock someone in your state of frailty is beneath me.
After the ritual, I have some particular needs in regards to new tunnels…
If they weren't I wouldn't have particular needs in regards to new tunnels.
The mole grabs them, then I make them suffer.
They say you have quite the ego.
Call me that again and I will pop your eyes like grapes.
Call me that again, and I will pop your eyes like grapes.
It's so nice to work with someone who understands their place.
How do you like working for the djinn
Fortunately for you, that's not the case.
Good luck on your quest for revenge… the small minded deserve to be culled.
That may be the first I've heard that.
So when do you use me to impress your new Baxter Society friends
Don't pretend you didn't think about betraying me.
What's to stop me from turning on you?
People say that you turned a new leaf.
They also say you've gone soft.
When I bring them to their knees, cut their throat
Do you know what you carry?
If this was another day, perhaps… but I doubt you'd be much use in the ritual without it… and once we succeed I will have no need for such trivial displays of power.
The moral delusions of the young do amuse me, yes.
You were hiding with the mole and his spokesman, were you not?
I imagine with your resources you could have found better companions.
So good that you feel compelled to blow it all up because you need your moment in the sun.
Of course. I'm sure they understand.
I mean it. You saw the world as it was and decided it was not acceptable to you. That's to be commended.
That being said, if you have an ill-timed bout of heroism and try to stop me from reaching my destiny I will make you suffer.
I'm surprised you wanted to team up with me.
Then watch closely Ivy… perhaps you'll learn something.
Oh god it's talking to me
Once we summon the patron you'll see for yourself.
So you say you're from The Deep
There's more to you than I expected Viscous.
Do you really think mocking me is a wise idea.
I don't waste time with frivolity.
Money can't be all you're after.
And here I thought I was supposed to be working with a professional.
How does it feel to be the black sheep of The Baxter Society?
Oh you are an exceptional liar.
Please, stay on the path you're on and you won't live long enough to end up like me.
I'm not invested in your survival, I just hate to see talent wasted.
No, because mentors only teach what they want you to learn. They are craven and use the young to live glories they could not achieve on their own.
Of course not. She sees potential in you that she's never seen in ages. You're special.
You're right. How silly of me.
I don't care how old you are. If you're competent you'll survive, if you're not you'll die - either way you're not my concern.
Did your masters at The Vatican send you? Or are you thinking for yourself for a change.
Please, you're still willing to work with me - I killed a work acquaintance at best.
Aren't you planning on offering me a benediction?
Thought you were in the business of saving souls.
You're right to have contempt for humanity.
No, you're governed by emotions not intellect… and as long as you are others will always see you as a joke.
It didn't. But when they came for me it was because they feared me… not because they mocked me.
I "stuck it to them" when I butchered my captors in Lost Whisper. The government's taken enough from me, they don't get to claim my wish as well.
That's your tactic. What's your goal.
Your designs for Long Island are completely untenable.
The American government won't simply cede an island to a domestic enemy.
I'm going to make sure we win. The safety of your minions are not my concern.
Thank you for your assistance your majesty.
You mask your power in a circus sideshow, it's pathetic.
I'm hiding from federal agents, not trying to be queen in a kingdom of misfits.
Don't be hard on yourself, people's morality always crumbles in the face of self-interest.
You are so very lucky that I need your help for the next 40 minutes or so
Presumably you're trying to summon the patron to make people forget about your last two collections.
Mina. I would rather wear my prison jumpsuit than that abomination you trotted out at fashion week.
I'm talking about your career, not the ritual. Vampires by their nature are stagnant, and you have chosen to work in a medium that is ever evolving.
Your unfinished hem experiment was definitely not
Never compare yourself to me again, worm.
That's a surprisingly useful offer Vyper.
If I say no are you still going to ask it?
Put down the knife and pick up a book.
A knife can only hurt your enemy when they're in front of you. Knowledge can hurt them from anywhere.
How often did your mother drop you?
Keeping a close eye on me?
How charming. What are you planning on asking the Patron for, Silver? A new liver?
How long are you going to squander your talents?
I know the cliché you are all-too keen to wrap yourself in. You're worse than a petulant teenager… at least they have the excuse that their brains aren't fully formed.
I don't speak Japanese but I know an insult when I hear one.
You were out matched from the beginning.
Euck, I got your filth all over me.
It's not wise to engage on my own.
The dead have no use for coin.
And now we press our advantage…
You thought you were better than me?!
I didn't escape the program just to die here…
We need to be doing better…
I should pick up those souls.
My help comes with a price.
With these hands I will destroy, and with these hands I will rebuild.
This city suits me… and it will be mine.
I've freed myself from the shackles of the past…and my future looks bright.
Kelvin, you can't run from me forever!
I don't need a team to kill them all.
Their team is down! Let's take what's ours!
I bought us time. Let's make good use of it.
I need to remember to upgrade my gear.
I need to buy a relic.
Maybe I should see what I can buy.
Wonder if the store has anything I need.
I can get something new at the store.
I can't let these souls go to waste.
I should pay the curiosity shop a visit…
The right purchase can cement our victory.
The objective was all that mattered.
We got what we came for.
Look at them scramble for some dignity…
The money's irrelevant, the objective is what really mattered.
Very well. If you don't want to win that's your business.
You don't think you need me? Please.
I have a burgeoning empire to run anyway…
One day you'll need me… and I'll see you beg for my help.
When you want victory, I'll be ready.
One day you will fail… and when you do remember this moment. The moment you could have chosen victory.
It's adorable that you think you don't need me.
Such a small thing that can cause so much damage.
This will tear through their ranks.
In time, this will wear down any objective….
Need to be careful when I'm aiming this…
One little spark is all it takes…
If they don't move, they'll be dead.
I will show them true power.
They will learn to fear me.
They will writhe, then they will die.
They'll know the end is coming.
It's important to let the fear sink in.
They know the end is upon them.
First I mark the target, then I hunt them down.
Once they're marked, their fate is sealed.
They have no chance for escape.
They won't hide behind the weak.
My bullets will seek my enemies.
They will cluster for safety…. And it will be their end…
Lightning will ripple through their army.
One bullet may lead to many deaths.
My lightning will dance amongst them.
Some well-placed shots are all it takes.
I will stand, and they will die.
Any who stands against me will die.
Either they run, or they die… both work for me.
Only a fool would oppose me.
I've had to scurry like a rat since I was a child… now THEY will be the ones who run.
When the storm comes, they will die.
Only those who keep their wits about them will survive…
They would be wise to fear me.
I'd hide if I were you…
All who oppose us will die!
The weak will sustain the strong.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Rat King, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
You're on your own for now.
I'll be back when I can.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
You all played your part to perfection.
My greatness will no longer be denied.
Soon the Patrons will bow to me.
Look on the face of your new god.
No one will stop me from getting what I deserve.
Greatness can be hindered, but it can never be stopped.
I tire of sulking in the shadows.
I remain unshackled by limits or fear.
Their suffering is as irrelevant as it is inevitable.
Check out what Rat King bought.
So the detective wants to be a hero….
Bebop is looking to pick a fight…
Ahhh so the Time Theif has made her appearance
I can smell Lash's hubris from here.
Shiv is going to try to stick us.
That bottom feeder Slork is around here
I see that wretched ball of goo.
Wraith will try to pick us off.
Ready to make them run for cover.
My lightning will spread across the sky.
Lightning will dance across the sky.
